comment: M16 exams: in test week (week 4) each class you take is graded by the class's stats (statGains) against 'difficulty', plus Grade (attendance) from data/school_classes.json. score = 50 + statWeight x (average class stat - difficulty) + gradeWeight x Grade, clamped 0..100. Letters by 'letters'. The report card (week 4 Friday) applies the letter's effects (teacher Grade, parent reaction) and the GPA's unlock flags.

parent.text: Your guardian reads the report card twice, then puts it on the fridge. Under a magnet. That's love.
"Not bad, new kid." A pat on the shoulder. Dinner is your favourite.
A long sigh. "We'll talk about it." You don't talk about it. That's somehow worse.
The report card goes in a drawer. The drawer goes very quiet. Grounded: your next weekend has less time.

unlocks.honor_roll: Honor roll: advanced classes that ask for good grades are open.
